<action type="say">
Here’s how to get that main checking account linked so it can show up here. I’ll keep it generic so it matches most banks—some menu names might differ slightly.

1) First, confirm you’re using the right login  
- If you’ve ever had multiple usernames/emails with this bank, log out and try signing in with the one you originally used when you opened the checking.  
- If you’re sure this is the right login, continue to step 2.

2) On the bank’s website (desktop/laptop)  
Once you’re signed in on the web:
1. Look for a menu called something like:
   - “Profile” or your name (top right), or  
   - “Settings,” “Account Services,” or “My Accounts.”
2. Inside that, look for:
   - “Account Access,” “Manage Accounts,” “Linked Accounts,” “Enroll Accounts,” or “Add existing account.”
3. Choose “Add existing account” / “Link internal account” / similar.
4. It will usually ask for:
   - The account type: choose “Checking.”  
   - Part of the account number (often the full or last 4 digits).  
   - Sometimes a nickname (e.g., “Main checking”).
5. Submit and confirm:
   - You may need to accept terms or confirm via an SMS/email code.
6. After a successful link, go back to the “Accounts” or “Accounts Overview” page and check if the checking account now appears.

3) On the bank’s mobile app (if you prefer phone)  
In the app after signing in:
1. Tap the main menu (≡ or your profile icon).
2. Look for:
   - “Settings,” “Profile,” “Manage accounts,” or “Account services.”
3. Then find an option like:
   - “Add/Link existing accounts,” “Show/hide accounts,” or “Enroll additional accounts.”
4. Select “Checking” and follow the prompts to:
   - Enter the account number (or last 4),  
   - Give it a nickname, and  
   - Confirm with any security code if asked.
5. Return to the main “Accounts” screen and verify the checking is now listed.

4) If you don’t see any “link/add existing account” option  
At that point, it usually means only support can join that checking to your login. Contact the bank by phone or secure message and say something close to:

- “I have a checking account ending in [last 4 digits] that isn’t showing under my online banking. Can you link it to this online profile/username so I can see it with my other accounts?”

They may verify:
- Your identity (ID questions, SMS code), and  
- The account number and whether you’re a primary owner.

Ask them to:
- “Make sure this checking account is set to be visible in online and mobile banking under my [username/email].”

5) After it’s linked  
Once support confirms it’s linked and you can see the checking account in your app or on the website under this login, tell me the nickname or the last 4 digits (e.g., “Checking ****1234”), and I’ll pull the balance here.

If you tell me whether you’re on the mobile app or the website right now, I can tailor these steps more precisely to your screen. </action>
